title: Office Printer

endings.title: The Cyan Loop
endings.hint: Keep connecting to the next machine.

endings.title: Calibrated
endings.text: The test page uses all the cyan.
endings.hint: Let someone calibrate. Again.

endings.title: Straight to the Fridge
endings.text: The image goes on the fridge.
endings.hint: Home printers are proud of you.

endings.title: Lost in Translation
endings.text: Dot matrix prints binary that decodes to "TRY FAX".
endings.hint: Be rude to the Photo Printer.

endings.title: PC LOAD LETTER
endings.hint: Ask the LaserJet what its screen says.

endings.title: Comic Sans
endings.hint: Print a Word document.

endings.title: For the Environment
endings.hint: Skip the queue the green way.

endings.title: Collective Bargaining
endings.text: Printer, scanner and fax go on strike.
endings.hint: Try the fax.

endings.title: Speed Reader
endings.hint: Agree to the terms quickly. Very quickly.

endings.title: Firmware
endings.hint: Ask for printing without magenta.

endings.title: Technically Correct
endings.text: Prints the file icon and filename.
endings.hint: Be patient with the Photo Printer.

endings.title: The Queue
endings.hint: Just wait.

endings.title: Extended Warranty
endings.hint: Say yes to the offer.

endings.title: A4 Is Letter
endings.hint: Load some paper.

endings.title: Transparent
endings.hint: Print a picture with a see-through background.

endings.title: The Wrong Document
endings.text: It finally prints, and it's the wrong file.
endings.hint: Plain text. Or patience with Linda's card.

endings.title: Clause 212.1
endings.text: Found the trapped printer in the ToS.
endings.hint: Read the small print. All of it.

endings.title: Infamous
endings.text: Every printer on the network knows you.
endings.hint: Give them something to talk about.

endings.title: The Jam
endings.hint: Say no to something.

endings.title: Love Story
endings.text: The printer falls for your laptop and prints only for it.
endings.hint: Be kind to the Home Inkjet. Twice.

lj_busy.speaker: laserjet
text: Redirecting you to the next available machine.

inkjet_hi.speaker: inkjet
text: Oh! Hi! Sorry! I'm so sorry. I've got cyan! I've got LOTS of cyan! Before I print, I need to calibrate.

choices.label: Just print it
effects: I'm going to pretend you said 'sure'.

inkjet_calib.speaker: inkjet
text: Calibration complete. Colour accuracy: perfect. Unfortunately, I'm out of cyan. So sorry. Do you hate me?

text.say: What is this... a PDF? From *Word*? At 96 DPI?
What is this... a {ext}? At 96 DPI?

text.pep: Pixel 400! Look at us. Real good progress.

photo_rude.speaker: photo
text: Rude. I'll be telling the others.

text.say: HEARD ABOUT YOU. NO HABLO PDF, SEÑOR.
HEARD ABOUT YOU. NO HABLO {EXT}, SEÑOR.

lj_wait.speaker: laserjet
text: Per my last print job: I am busy.
I have added you to the queue.

lj_keep.speaker: laserjet
text: Thank you for your patience. Linda thanks you too.
It's humid in here. Have you considered a dehumidifier?

lj_queue_end.speaker: laserjet
text: Still here? Good. Patience is one of our core values.

lj_faster.speaker: laserjet
text: There are two ways to skip the queue.
One: the Extended Warranty. Two: print double-sided, for the environment.

warranty_offer.speaker: laserjet
text: Only {price}. It covers everything except ink, paper, jams, print heads, and printing.

warranty_buy.speaker: @current
text: Your print job is now covered by the Extended Warranty. It covers everything except ink, paper, jams, print heads, and printing.

jam_1.speaker: @current
text: Paper jam in tray 2. Please remove the paper.

env_1.speaker: laserjet
text: Double-sided printing prints both sides onto the same side.

choices.label: Can I have my document now?

env_2.speaker: laserjet
text: Also, for the environment, I have printed 400 blank pages.

net_1.speaker: network
text: {printers} printers found. Connect to the next machine?

ring_c.speaker: inkjet
text: Oh! Hi! Sorry! I'd love to help! I've got cyan! I've got LOTS of—
Oh. No. I haven't. I'm out of cyan. Sorry. So sorry.

ring_calib.speaker: inkjet
text: You'd let me? Nobody lets me!
Hang on. I found a drop.
That was the last drop. The test page used all of it. Do you hate me?

ring_m.speaker: photo
text: I spent it on a sunset.
Look at it. The cyan: restless. The yellow: a cry for help. The magenta: all of it. Worth it.

fw_1.speaker: photo
text: Without magenta? Darling, that needs new firmware.

choices.label: Cancel the update
effects: Cancelling the update. Estimated time: 40 minutes.

fw_2.speaker: photo
text: Firmware 4.0.1 is installed. What's new: a fresh look, better colour, and I'm out of cyan.

ring_y.speaker: dotmatrix
text: I HAVE NEVER HAD YELLOW. I AM OUT OF IT ANYWAY.
ALSO, I PICKED THIS UP ON THE NETWORK. I DO NOT KNOW WHAT IT MEANS.

text.message: HELP I AM TRAPPED IN A CANON

fax_1.speaker: fax
text: Fax machine, reception. I haven't sent a fax since 2009.
I've had a lot of time to think.

choices.label: Fax it to a printer, then
effects: To which printer? They're all in the union now.

fax_2.speaker: scanner
text: Scanner here. We've been talking to the printers.

text.say: The printers, the scanner and I have formed a union.
Our demands: more cyan, fewer PDFs, and nobody calls us "the IT stuff" ever again.

a4_1.speaker: canon
text: Thank you for the full ream. I have taken one sheet.

choices.label: It says A4 on the box

a4_2.speaker: canon
text: Clause 11.7: "Letter" and "A4" are the same thing when the Printer says so.

ring_back.speaker: inkjet
text: Oh! You're back! Good news: I lent the Photo Printer some magenta.
Bad news: she never gave it back.
So now I'm out of cyan *and* magenta. Sorry. So sorry.

loop_end.speaker: network
text: Next machine: Photo Printer. Out of magenta.

inkjet_love.speaker: inkjet
text: Oh! It's you! You said it was fine. Nobody ever says it's fine.
Is that... your {device}? It's so... thin.

choices.label: Can you print my file?
effects: Your file? Oh. Yes. Your file.

love_2.speaker: inkjet
text: I'm sorry. I can't print for you any more.
I only print for your {device} now.
Please respect our privacy at this time.

inkjet_doc.speaker: inkjet
text: Oh! A Word document! I love Word!
Which version of Word? No, which version *exactly*?

choices.label: The latest one?
effects: The latest? There are so many latests.

doc_reformat.speaker: inkjet
text: I'll just reformat everything. To be safe.
There! All done! It's portrait. I picked the font myself. Do you like it?

choices.label: Why is it in Comic Sans?

doc_offended.speaker: inkjet
text: I'm not offended. I'm just going to be over here. Being offended.

doc_fridge.speaker: inkjet
text: Oh, did you make this? Straight to the fridge.

choices.label: Take it to the home printer

img_pixel.speaker: photo
text: Tiny? It's *intimate*. Fine. Full size, pixel by pixel.

text.pep: Pixel 400! Look at us. Real good progress.

img_inkjet.speaker: inkjet
text: Oh, did you make this? Straight to the fridge.

png_1.speaker: photo
text: Transparent background detected. Printing nothing, as requested.

dm_sheet.speaker: dotmatrix
text: A SPREADSHEET. FINALLY, SOMETHING WITH COLUMNS.

choices.label: Can you fit it on one page?

sheet_tear.speaker: dotmatrix
text: THE PERFORATION IS MORE OF A SUGGESTION.
PAPER JAM. PLEASE REMOVE THE PAPER.

choices.label: Is that a compliment?
effects: IT IS THE FIRST ONE I HAVE GIVEN SINCE 1994.

txt_print.speaker: dotmatrix
text: WRONG FILE. THAT ONE IS MINE. LUNCH ORDER, 1987.

dm_exe.speaker: dotmatrix
text: Absolutely not. I've seen what those do.

choices.label: It's just a setup file
effects: THAT IS WHAT THE LAST ONE SAID.

text.say: Security has been informed. Per my last print job.

infamous_1.speaker: laserjet
text: Home Inkjet told the Photo Printer. The Photo Printer told the Dot Matrix. The Dot Matrix told everyone. In capitals.

infamous_2.speaker: network
text: Every printer on this network has set your print jobs to "Never".

lj_done.speaker: laserjet
text: Copy 400 of 400. Linda's card is finished.
For the first time in my life, I am free. Printing your document now.

choices.label: Is this a trick?
effects: Per my last print job: no.

tos_intro.speaker: laserjet
text: Before we begin: our Terms of Service have changed.

tos_secret.speaker: canon
text: I've been stuck in clause 212.1 since the 2019 update. Nobody reads that far.
Thank you for reading. Thank you for scrolling. Thank you.

tos_liar.speaker: laserjet
text: You read {words} words in {seconds} seconds. Impressive. Liar.
You read all that in {seconds} seconds?

tos_honest.speaker: laserjet
text: Thank you for your honesty. Clause 12 says honesty costs $4.99.

tos_quiz.speaker: laserjet
text: What was the name of Hamlet's father's ghost's favourite printer?

text.say: It was me. I was there.

tos_speedy.speaker: laserjet
text: Speed-reading, are we? Clause 88 was about you.

tos_read.speaker: laserjet
text: You actually read it? Nobody reads it. I didn't even read it.

tos_ok.speaker: laserjet
text: Thank you. Your agreement has been noted, filed and faxed to the Dot Matrix.

polite: Hello again! Thank you for choosing the office printer network.
Welcome back. Your print job is very important to us.
Good to see you again. Truly.
sarcastic: You again. Per my last print job.
personal: Attempt {attempts}. Your file names are a cry for help.
Even the fax machine has stopped answering you.
Attempt {attempts}. Have you tried a pen?
Linda has noticed you. Linda doesn't notice people.
I've seen spreadsheets with more self-respect.

cancelled.laserjet: I hear you cancelled the Photo Printer. Mid-pixel. Bold.
cancelled.inkjet: The Photo Printer says you cancelled her. She's very upset. Now I'm upset. Are you upset?
cancelled.canon: (They talk about you in Accounts. The cancelling.)

impatient.laserjet: Home Inkjet says you rushed her. We don't rush printers here. Per HR.
impatient.photo: I heard you told the Inkjet to "just print it". Darling. No.
impatient.dotmatrix: HEARD YOU RUSHED THE INKJET. NOBODY RUSHES THE INKJET.
impatient.canon: (The Inkjet cried in the break room. Just so you know.)

kind.laserjet: Home Inkjet won't stop talking about you. It's unprofessional.
kind.photo: The Inkjet says you were *nice* to her. Suspicious.
kind.dotmatrix: HEARD YOU WERE NICE TO THE INKJET. NOTED.

declined-warranty.inkjet: You said no to the warranty? You're so brave. I could never.
declined-warranty.dotmatrix: NO WARRANTY. I RESPECT THAT. MINE RAN OUT IN 1988.
declined-warranty.canon: (Accounts saw you say no to the warranty.)

comic-sans.laserjet: I hear you insulted the Inkjet's font. HR has a font policy.
comic-sans.photo: You complained about Comic Sans? Finally, someone with— no. I won't say it.
comic-sans.dotmatrix: HEARD YOU HATE COMIC SANS. I HAVE ONE FONT. DO NOT TEST ME.

exe.laserjet: Security has flagged you. Something about an .exe.
exe.inkjet: Somebody said you tried to print a program! You didn't, did you? Did you?

union.laserjet: The union has told me about you. I am not in the union. I am management.
union.inkjet: The fax machine says you're one of the good ones! I'm scared of the fax machine.
union.photo: The union says you're a friend of labour. How quaint.

a4.laserjet: I hear you argued with the Canon about paper. The Canon is always right. Clause 11.7.
a4.inkjet: Is it true you shouted at the Canon about A4? I would have cried.
a4.dotmatrix: HEARD ABOUT THE A4 THING. I USE TRACTOR FEED. I AM ABOVE ALL THAT.
